power_in_light.name: Power in Light
power_in_light.text: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 2% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

wand_specialization.name: Wand Specialization
wand_specialization.text: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

twin_disciplines.name: Twin Disciplines
twin_disciplines.text: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 1%.

silent_resolve.name: Silent Resolve
silent_resolve.text: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 10% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 5%.

holy_precision.name: Holy Precision
holy_precision.text: Increases your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6%.

improved_power_word_shield.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
improved_power_word_shield.text: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 7%.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.text: Gives you a 50% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

mental_agility.name: Mental Agility
mental_agility.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 3%.

inner_focus.name: Inner Focus
inner_focus.text: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.text: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

improved_inner_fire.name: Improved Inner Fire
improved_inner_fire.text: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 15% and increases its total charges by 4.

soul_warding.name: Soul Warding
soul_warding.text: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

improved_mana_burn.name: Improved Mana Burn
improved_mana_burn.text: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 0.5 sec.

penance.name: Penance
penance.text: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 96 Holy damage to an enemy, or 233 healing to an ally. Instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

renewed_hope.name: Renewed Hope
renewed_hope.text: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 2% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 1 sec.

divine_aegis.name: Divine Aegis
divine_aegis.text: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 5% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

power_infusion.name: Power Infusion
power_infusion.text: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

twilight_focus.name: Twilight Focus
twilight_focus.text: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

improved_renew.name: Improved Renew
improved_renew.text: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

holy_specialization.name: Holy Specialization
holy_specialization.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

spell_warding.name: Spell Warding
spell_warding.text: Reduces all spell damage taken by 2%.

divine_fury.name: Divine Fury
divine_fury.text: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.1 sec.

holy_nova.name: Holy Nova
holy_nova.text: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 31 to 36 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 68 to 77. These effects cause no threat.

blessed_recovery.name: Blessed Recovery
blessed_recovery.text: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

inspiration.name: Inspiration
inspiration.text: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 8% for 15 sec.

holy_reach.name: Holy Reach
holy_reach.text: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.

improved_healing.name: Improved Healing
improved_healing.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 5%.

searing_light.name: Searing Light
searing_light.text: Increases your Holy damage done by 2%, and gives a 5% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

binding_heal.name: Binding Heal
binding_heal.text: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 346 to 403. Low threat.

litany_of_light.name: Litany of Light
litany_of_light.text: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 5% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

spirit_of_redemption.name: Spirit of Redemption
spirit_of_redemption.text: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

spiritual_guidance.name: Spiritual Guidance
spiritual_guidance.text: Increases your spell healing by up to 5% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 1% of your total Spirit.

spiritual_healing.name: Spiritual Healing
spiritual_healing.text: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 3%.

prayer_of_mending.name: Prayer of Mending
prayer_of_mending.text: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 247 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

shadow_focus.name: Shadow Focus
shadow_focus.text: Increases your chance to hit with your Shadow spells by 1%.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.text: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

spirit_tap.name: Spirit Tap
spirit_tap.text: Gives you a 20% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target. For the duration, your Mana will regenerate at a 50% of normal rate while casting.

shadow_affinity.name: Shadow Affinity
shadow_affinity.text: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 10%.

improved_shadow_word_pain.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
improved_shadow_word_pain.text: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3 sec.

shadow_reach.name: Shadow Reach
shadow_reach.text: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 10%.

improved_mind_blast.name: Improved Mind Blast
improved_mind_blast.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 0.5 sec.

improved_psychic_scream.name: Improved Psychic Scream
improved_psychic_scream.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 2 sec.

mind_flay.name: Mind Flay
mind_flay.text: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 104 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

improved_mind_flay.name: Improved Mind Flay
improved_mind_flay.text: Your Mind Flay now deals 10% more damage, gains 5 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 35%.

improved_fade.name: Improved Fade
improved_fade.text: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 3 sec.

vampiric_embrace.name: Vampiric Embrace
vampiric_embrace.text: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. Vampiric Embrace also grants a chance for your Spirit Tap talent to trigger when enemies afflicted by it die.

shadow_weaving.name: Shadow Weaving
shadow_weaving.text: Your Shadow damage spells have a 33% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

silence.name: Silence
silence.text: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

devouring_contagion.name: Devouring Contagion
devouring_contagion.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 25%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 5 yards for the remaining duration.

early_demise.name: Early Demise
early_demise.text: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 15%.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.text: Increases your Shadow damage done by 2%.

shadowform.name: Shadowform
shadowform.text: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
